description: This PHP class defines a FilesystemAdapter that extends Symfony's FilesystemAdapter for caching purposes within the OrangeHRM project. It is located under the namespace OrangeHRM\Framework\Cache and effectively acts as a wrapper or extension point for Symfony's caching adapter, potentially for customization or configuration specific to OrangeHRM.

classes.name: FilesystemAdapter
classes.description: Extends Symfony's FilesystemAdapter class without adding additional methods or properties, serving as a custom extension point within the OrangeHRM framework.
